{{Quote|Han Solo, meet Bana. He's here on behalf of the Hutt resistance.''"<br />"''And an investor in this &hellip; place. Despite which I've been ill treated. Kept in close quarters for the journey. Very inhospitable.|Lando Calrissian and Bana Besadii Diori|<ref name="Rebirth" />}}
'''Bana Besadii Diori''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] in the [[Besadii/Legends|Besadii]] clan. He was a member of the [[Hutt underground|Hutt resistance]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], and helped supply some funds for [[Shelter]] after meeting with [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] and [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]]. He initially asked if the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] would fight alongside the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], but eventually settled for the use the [[Great River]] to run weapons and supplies for the resistance. He was a cousin of [[Randa Besadii Diori]].<ref name="Rebirth" />
